findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are stored in plaintext as Lambda environment variables directly in the Terraform source, exposing long-lived AWS credentials to anyone with access to the code repository, Terraform state, or Lambda console/API.

The Lambda function does not configure a KMS CMK (kms_key_arn) for encrypting environment variables at rest, so sensitive values like the embedded credentials rely only on the default AWS-managed key rather than customer-managed encryption.
The function uses nodejs12.x, a Node.js runtime that has reached end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities in the language runtime.
